text: Ninja Gaiden NES: Items, Weapons, and Stage 2-2 Notes. Items: Blue bags give 500 points and red bags give 1000 points. Blue spirit tiles give 5 points and red spirit tiles give 10 points; spirit points power secondary weapons. Time Freeze hourglasses freeze action on screen for approximately five seconds. Health potions restore six lost bars of health. Extra lives are extremely hard to find. Weapons: Throwing stars cost 3 spirit points each. Windmill stars return like a boomerang and cost 5 spirit points. Flames throw three sets of flames and cost 5 spirit points per set. Fire wheel needs no spirit points, replaces your current weapon, and disappears after five seconds. Stage 2-2: Enemies toss daggers from a column, machine gunners and commandos attack from both sides, and a red Spirit Points tile above the column at the end of the section is easy to miss. Q: How many spirit points does a throwing star cost? Q: How long does the Time Freeze item freeze enemies? Q: Where is the red Spirit Points tile in Stage 2-2 easy to miss?

Ninja Gaiden NES: Secondary Weapons and Stage 4-3 Windmill Star. Secondary weapons: Throwing star, a basic secondary weapon Ryu throws in a straight line ahead; costs 3 spirit points per star. Windmill star, more powerful than a regular throwing star, returns to the thrower like a boomerang and continuously flies back and forth if it misses until caught; costs 5 spirit points. Flames, three sets of flames flying off in tight spirals that float up at slightly different angles, useful for enemies perched above you; costs 5 spirit points per set. Fire wheel, surrounds you with fire that eliminates enemies in contact; needs no spirit points, replaces your current weapon, and disappears after five seconds. Stage 4-3: a very high candle contains a Windmill Star, accessible from the ground using the Flame technique, otherwise wall jump to the top of the left column. Q: How many spirit points does a throwing star cost? Q: How do I get the Windmill Star in Stage 4-3? Q: How long does the fire wheel last?

Ninja Gaiden Stages 2-2 and 5-3 Notes. Stage 2-2: Run left and leap over gaps quickly after picking up the Fire Wheel technique, found in the insect to the left of the insect holding a health restoring potion. Without Fire Wheel, enemies are hard to pass. Stage 5-3: Section 1 has a Flame technique above the small column and a red spirit tile. Section 2 has jet pack ninjas and throwing stars that can be slashed away with your sword. Section 5 has a Flame technique and red bonus point bag above the dagger tossing demon. Section 6 has a blue Spirit tile and the Windmill Star on the candles. Q: Where do I find the Fire Wheel technique in Stage 2-2? Q: Where is the Flame technique in Stage 5-3? Q: How do I deal with the throwing stars in Stage 5-3 Section 2?

Ninja Gaiden NES: Weapons and Act 6-5 Boss Notes. Throwing star: basic secondary weapon; Ryu throws it in a straight line ahead; costs 3 spirit points per star. Windmill star: returns to the thrower like a boomerang; continuously flies back and forth if it misses until caught; costs 5 spirit points. Flames: throws three sets of flames in tight spirals that float up at slightly different angles; useful against enemies perched above; costs 5 spirit points per set. Fire wheel: surrounds you in fire that eliminates contacting enemies; requires no spirit points, replaces your current weapon, and disappears after five seconds. Act 6-5: the heart is tied to the health meter; remove the head by jumping and hitting it twice, and the tail by squatting and striking it repeatedly.
